instruction: A candid documentary photograph, wide shot from a high angle, showing an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. In the center of the frame, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) is seen from behind, balancing on his left leg while lifting his right leg backward. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left, watching his movement. The room is brightly lit by overhead lights, highlighting the red carpet, white walls, and a printer in the background.
